No source pages or bytes were acquired. The literal catalog string тип. Альтшулера is preserved as typography evidence and is not converted into a publisher or provision-activity claim. The holdings are not ToS Items, the NLR source identifier has no independently resolved current record, and no responsibility, textual equivalence, new derivation, rights, or semantic claim is created.
